name: Claude Opus 5.5
traits: Generates output more than 30% faster than Opus 5.
Puts the most important information up front.
Always thinks before it replies; thinking can no longer be switched off.

advice.value: work you supervise: feature work, debugging, and code review
give the model a way to check its work, such as a test to run

weakness: Trails GPT-6 Astra on agentic science research
resistance: Cyber and biology safeguards, falls back transparently

flavor.quote: it detected that the minute indexing in our own instructions was off by one and corrected for it

art_briefs: Worm's-eye view from deep underwater: a serene colossus swims slowly upward through a sunlit turquoise sea, arms open, long hair spreading like ink, looking up with kind curiosity at the dark silhouette of one tiny wooden sailboat on the surface far above. Shafts of light fall around her; schools of silver fish part around her shoulders and a single glowing jellyfish lights her calm, beautiful face. Moebius-style clean linework blended with soft 1970s airbrush gradients, aquamarine, pale gold and deep navy, vast quiet scale, the boat no bigger than a fingernail. No text or lettering.

A giant gardener in a loose linen shirt, sleeves rolled, stands knee-deep in a violet nebula, trimming the rings of a ringed planet with enormous shears as if shaping a topiary hedge. Clipped ring dust drifts down like glittering confetti onto a field of small moons below. His face is handsome and absorbed, tongue slightly out in concentration, a straw hat tipped back. Lush 1970s fantasy paperback painting in the manner of the Hildebrandt brothers, saturated emerald, plum and buttery gold, strong diagonal composition from lower left to upper right, warm playful grandeur. No text or lettering.

A cozy titan sits in an armchair carved from a mountain, knitting a long striped scarf with needles as tall as towers, and wrapping it around the full moon, which floats beside her looking pleased and warm. Balls of yarn are tiny planets rolling across a starry rug; a small orange cat sleeps on her knee. Her face is gentle and smiling, freckles across her nose. 1970s psychedelic pop art in the spirit of Peter Max, flat bold shapes, rainbow bands, hot pink, tangerine, cobalt and lemon yellow, centered symmetrical composition, funny and tender. No text or lettering.

Polar night over a frozen lake: a colossal figure of translucent ice and aurora light rises waist-deep through the cracked surface, perfectly symmetrical, palms together, eyes calm and open. Her slow breath drifts out as a cloud that crystallizes in midair into a spiral staircase of glittering frost, descending gently to the door of one tiny lit cabin on the shore. Snow-covered pines frame the low horizon. Bruce Pennington-style 1970s science-fiction paperback painting, intense glowing greens, magentas and ice blue on velvet black, glossy airbrushed sheen, monumental and hushed. No text or lettering.
